text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [and rejoice in] it.

arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
text: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Wondrous is the affair of the believer, for there is good in it all, and this applies to no one but the believer. If something good happens to him, he is thankful, and that is good for him."

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
text: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins."

arabic: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
text: And despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
No fatigue, nor disease, nor sorrow, nor sadness, nor hurt, nor distress befalls a Muslim, even if it were the prick he receives from a thorn, but that Allah expiates some of his sins for that.
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
text: And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "...and if some adversity befalls him, he is patient, and that is good for him."
